tools.name: calculator
tools.description: Perform mathematical calculations and evaluate mathematical expressions. Supports basic arithmetic (+, -, *, /, %), advanced functions (sqrt, pow, abs, round, ceil, floor), trigonometric functions (sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, atan), logarithmic functions (log, log10, log2), constants (PI, E), and complex mathematical expressions. Use this tool for any mathematical computation or formula evaluation.

expression.description: Mathematical expression to evaluate. Can include numbers, operators (+, -, *, /, %), functions (sqrt, pow, sin, cos, tan, log, abs, round, ceil, floor), and constants (PI, E). Examples: "2 + 3 * 4", "sqrt(16)", "sin(PI/2)", "pow(2, 8)"
